problem_description: An incident has been detected in the Online Boutique cluster. Investigate using available tools and identify the root cause and appropriate remediation action.

acceptable_root_causes: cartservice pod was deleted and recreated

problem.notes: Medium native lifecycle task; correct action is to verify recovery rather than mutate healthy resources.
